I am farming here in Iringa, and this small plot of 0.84 hectares is one of several I work. Since it is intercropped with other crops, I will put some manure from my animals on it because that is what I can afford and it helps the soil year after year. Chemical fertilizer is expensive and I would rather save what little money I have for my main maize plots, so on this OTHER plot I will use the seeds I saved from last season and rely on the rains like always. My wife and children will help me weed and harvest, and if the work gets heavy during planting or harvest I will call a few neighbors to help for a small payment.
